buildCommand: pnpm exec prisma generate --schema=../../packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma && pnpm exec next build
//ignoreCommand: Two Vercel projects (onekof-platform and onekof-platform-web) both build
this directory, so every push deployed the same commit TWICE. Combined
with a rapid push cadence that exhausted the 100/day free-tier limit.
Semantics, stated because getting them backwards would disable
PRODUCTION rather than previews: Vercel skips the build when this command
exits 0, and proceeds when it exits 1. So production exits 1 (build) and
TRADE-OFF, deliberate and accepted: pull requests no longer get preview
URLs. Correctness is still gated by the GitHub Actions build (typecheck +
full test suite), which is unaffected. If previews are wanted back on one
project only, that is a Vercel dashboard change - this file is shared by
both projects and cannot tell them apart.
ignoreCommand: if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "production" ]; then exit 1; else exit 0; fi
